log_snippet:
org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: Fatal error: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
	at com.zaxxer.hikari.pool.HikariPool.getConnection(HikariPool.java:213)
	at com.fintech.gateway.db.TransactionRepository.save(TransactionRepository.java:45)
root_cause: HikariCP pool size (max 20) was inadequate for flash sale surge traffic.
fix_applied: Increased HikariCP max-pool-size to 50 and set idle-timeout to 30000ms.
notes: Immediate recovery of card authorization endpoints.

log_snippet:
ERROR [upi-switch-worker-4] c.f.u.NPCIClient: Timeout waiting for HTTP response from npci.npci.org.in:8443 after 5000ms
java.net.SocketTimeoutException: Read timed out
root_cause: NPCI primary H2H link latency spike; secondary failover route was disabled in routing table.
fix_applied: Enabled auto-failover to NPCI secondary link B via config flag UPI_NPCI_AUTO_FAILOVER=true.

log_snippet:
ERROR: deadlock detected
DETAIL: Process 18402 waits for ShareLock on transaction 881023; blocked by process 18409.
Process 18409 waits for ExclusiveLock on tuple (142,8) of relation 'account_balances'.
root_cause: Unordered balance locking in concurrent double-entry ledger transfers.
fix_applied: Enforced strict account ID sorting order prior to acquiring SELECT FOR UPDATE locks.
notes: Eliminated deadlock errors under concurrent transfer stress.

log_snippet:
OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'
redis.clients.jedis.exceptions.JedisDataException: ERR command not allowed under OOM memory condition
root_cause: JWT token revocation blacklist keys were stored without TTL expiration.
fix_applied: Flushed expired blacklist keys and enforced 24h TTL on all revocation entries.

log_snippet: javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: PKIX path validation failed: sun.security.provider.certpath.SunCertPathBuilderException: unable to find valid certification path to requested target
root_cause: Stripe sandbox TLS intermediate certificate expired on gateway egress node.
fix_applied: Updated CA truststore with renewed Let's Encrypt / Stripe CA bundle.

log_snippet: FATAL c.f.u.hsm.ThalesHSMClient: HSM session pool empty. Error code: 0x80040005 HSM_ERR_SESSION_MAX
root_cause: HSM PIN verification sessions were not closed in finally block during exception flow.
fix_applied: Wrapped HSM session acquisition in try-with-resources auto-closeable block.

log_snippet:
org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already
	at com.zaxxer.hikari.pool.HikariPool.getConnection(HikariPool.java:213)
root_cause: Increased app replica count to 15 which exceeded PostgreSQL max_connections limit (100).
fix_applied: Increased Postgres max_connections to 300 directly in postgresql.conf.
notes: WORKED INITIALLY, but caused high DB CPU later (see INC-2024-028 for conflicting advice!).

log_snippet: WARN [upi-worker-12] c.f.u.NPCIHandler: ACK timeout for txn_id=UPI9920104. Retrying (1/3)...
root_cause: Transient network packet loss between VPC peering gateway and bank network.
fix_applied: Restarted upi-switch pod deployment to flush stale socket connections.
notes: Pod restart resolved transient socket deadlock.

log_snippet:
java.lang.ArithmeticException: Rounding necessary
	at java.base/java.math.BigDecimal.divide(BigDecimal.java:1766)
	at com.fintech.ledger.CurrencyConverter.toUSD(CurrencyConverter.java:88)
root_cause: Division without explicit RoundingMode in INR to USD conversion.
fix_applied: Set explicit MathContext.DECIMAL128 and RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN on all currency conversions.
notes: Prevented arithmetic exceptions on fractional cents.

log_snippet: ERROR c.f.a.OAuthValidator: Failed to query token revocation status from Redis Sentinel cluster: Connection refused
root_cause: Redis Sentinel master node failover hung due to quorum misconfiguration.
fix_applied: Reconfigured Redis Sentinel quorum from 3 to 2 nodes and updated failover timeout to 5000ms.
notes: Sentinel successfully selected new master node.

log_snippet: org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.CommitFailedException: Commit cannot be completed since the group has already rebalanced and assigned the partitions to another member
root_cause: Webhook notification processing time exceeded max.poll.interval.ms (300000ms).
fix_applied: Increased max.poll.interval.ms to 600000ms and max.poll.records to 50.

log_snippet:
org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already
	at com.zaxxer.hikari.pool.HikariPool.getConnection(HikariPool.java:213)
root_cause: Surge in card auth requests exhausted DB connection pool.
fix_applied: Increased max_connections to 400 on DB master node.
notes: Quick fix worked for 2 hours, but degraded Postgres IOPS performance later.

log_snippet: WARN [lag-monitor] Consumer group upi-settlement-group lag is 452,102 messages (threshold: 10,000)
root_cause: Single partition bottleneck on upi-settlement topic with low partition count (4).
fix_applied: Increased upi-settlement topic partitions from 4 to 16 and scaled consumer replicas to 16.

log_snippet:
java.io.IOException: No space left on device
	at java.base/java.io.FileOutputStream.writeBytes(Native Method)
	at com.fintech.ledger.AuditLogger.append(AuditLogger.java:112)
root_cause: Verbose DEBUG audit logging filled /var/log/ledger disk volume.
fix_applied: Truncated old debug logs, changed log level to INFO, and configured logrotate to S3 bucket.

log_snippet: com.unboundid.ldap.sdk.LDAPException: result code 85 (client-side timeout waiting for connection from pool)
root_cause: Internal admin portal SSO LDAP connection pool max-connections cap (10) reached.
fix_applied: Increased LDAP client pool size to 40 connections with 5000ms validation check.

log_snippet: io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CallNotPermittedException: CircuitBreaker 'visa-gateway' is OPEN and does not permit further calls
root_cause: Visa partner network endpoint experienced 100% 502 Bad Gateway responses.
fix_applied: Switched payment routing rule to secondary acquirer Mastercard for Visa card BINs.
notes: Transaction flow rerouted around failing partner.

log_snippet: WARN [upi-worker-08] c.f.u.NPCIHandler: ACK timeout for txn_id=UPI4481023. Retrying (1/3)...
root_cause: Expired SSL client certificate on NPCI outbound connector node.
fix_applied: Restarted upi-switch pod deployment to attempt quick fix.
notes: FAILED FIX: Pod restart did NOT resolve outage because root cause was expired mTLS client cert (see INC-2024-035).

log_snippet:
ERROR: deadlock detected
DETAIL: Process 22100 waits for ShareLock on transaction 991044; blocked by process 22104.
root_cause: Batch reconciliation process ran without account ID sorting order.
fix_applied: Applied account ID sorting to batch reconciliation query locking clause.

log_snippet: com.auth0.jwt.exceptions.SignatureVerificationException: The Token's Signature resulted invalid when verified using the Algorithm: HmacSHA256
root_cause: Key rotation script updated auth-service active signing key before pushing new public key to verification sidecars.
fix_applied: Pushed dual-key verification patch so auth-service validates tokens signed by both previous and current keys.
notes: Zero invalid signature drops during key transition.

log_snippet:
org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already
	at com.zaxxer.hikari.pool.HikariPool.getConnection(HikariPool.java:213)
root_cause: High direct connection count crashed Postgres CPU (100%). Alex's previous advice of raising max_connections to 400 caused connection thrashing.
fix_applied: CONFLICTING ADVICE FIX: Deployed PgBouncer connection pooler in transaction mode with max_client_conn=1000 and default_pool_size=40.
notes: CONFLICTING ADVICE RESOLVED: Proved PgBouncer query pooling is vastly superior to blindly increasing max_connections.

log_snippet:
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
	at com.fintech.upi.limiter.SlidingWindowRateLimiter.cleanUp(SlidingWindowRateLimiter.java:94)
root_cause: Sliding window rate limiter retained stale VPA buckets in ConcurrentHashMap without expiration cleanup.
fix_applied: Replaced custom HashMap rate limiter with Redis-backed token bucket algorithm with automatic TTL.

log_snippet:
org.apache.kafka.common.errors.SerializationException: Error deserializing key/value for partition ledger-events-2 at offset 881023
Caused by: com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.exc.UnrecognizedPropertyException: Unrecognized field 'txn_fee_micros'
root_cause: Upstream schema change added new JSON field without setting @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = true).
fix_applied: Added @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = true) to LedgerEvent DTO class.
notes: Consumer unblocked and resumed parsing messages.

log_snippet: ERROR c.f.g.idempotency.RedisLockManager: Could not acquire lock 'idempotency:txn_99201' within 3000ms timeout
root_cause: Idempotency Redlock key release failed when worker thread was interrupted by GC pause.
fix_applied: Switched from Redlock to single-node Redis Lua script with strict 10s auto-release lease time.

log_snippet: ERROR [upi-connector-2] c.f.u.NPCIClient: mTLS handshake failed: SSLHandshakeException: Received fatal alert: certificate_expired
root_cause: Expired NPCI mTLS client certificate on connector nodes.
fix_applied: Renewed NPCI mTLS client certificate in Kubernetes secret vault and rolled connector deployments.
notes: Proper resolution for NPCI ACK timeout when caused by mTLS expiry.

log_snippet:
OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'
redis.clients.jedis.exceptions.JedisDataException: ERR command not allowed under OOM memory condition
root_cause: REPEATED INCIDENT: New microservice feature wrote session telemetry to Redis without TTL.
fix_applied: Set volatile-lru eviction policy on Redis master instance and added mandatory TTL linter rule.
notes: Permanent prevention of Redis OOM crashes.

log_snippet:
ERROR: deadlock detected
DETAIL: Process 30120 waits for ExclusiveLock on relation 'merchant_settlements'
root_cause: Merchant settlement cron job executed concurrent UPDATE statements across unordered merchant IDs.
fix_applied: Sorted merchant IDs in ascending order prior to batch UPDATE execution.

log_snippet: org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
root_cause: Unreleased DB connections in legacy refund webhook handler.
fix_applied: Wrapped refund DB query handle in try-with-resources statement to guarantee connection closure.

log_snippet: org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already
root_cause: Tried increasing max_connections to 500 without PgBouncer.
fix_applied: Increased max_connections to 500.
notes: FAILED FIX: Postgres server ran out of RAM due to per-connection work_mem allocation. Crashed DB node.

log_snippet: ERROR [upi-switch-worker-1] c.f.u.NPCIClient: Timeout waiting for response from NPCI H2H endpoint
root_cause: NPCI H2H link congestion during festival sale peak.
fix_applied: Activated adaptive throttle rate limiter on UPI payment request queue (max 500 TPS).

log_snippet: com.auth0.jwt.exceptions.SignatureVerificationException: Invalid signature
root_cause: Stale public key cached in auth-service pod local memory.
fix_applied: Triggered cache eviction endpoint /api/v1/auth/cache/clear on all auth-service nodes.

log_snippet: java.lang.ArithmeticException: Non-terminating decimal expansion; no exact representable decimal result.
root_cause: Dividing transaction fee by 3 without specifying scale and RoundingMode.
fix_applied: Specified scale=4 and RoundingMode.HALF_UP on fee division calculation.
